# opencode-hindsight

**OpenCode implementation of Hindsight plugin** — Provides persistent memory for OpenCode AI assistants across sessions and projects.

## Project Overview

opencode-hindsight is an OpenCode plugin that gives AI coding agents persistent, semantic memory using [Hindsight](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight) as the backend. It stores memories across sessions and projects, auto-detects when to save, injects relevant context on first message, and handles context compaction.

### Repository
- GitHub: https://github.com/opencode-community/opencode-hindsight
- Gitee: https://gitee.com/zwidny/opencode-hindsight

## Quick Start

### 1. Deploy Hindsight Server

Hindsight is the semantic memory backend. Deploy via Docker Compose (pre-configured for DeepSeek):

```bash
cd deploy/
echo "HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_API_KEY=your-deepseek-api-key" > .env
docker compose up -d
```

For Chinese users unable to access ghcr.io, use the Huawei SWR mirror:
```bash
docker pull swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/cn/hindsight:latest
docker run -d --name hindsight -p 8888:8888 -v hindsight_data:/data swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/cn/hindsight:latest
```

Verify: `curl http://localhost:8888/health` → `{"status":"healthy","database":"connected"}`

### 2. Install the Plugin

```bash
git clone https://github.com/opencode-community/opencode-hindsight.git
cd opencode-hindsight
bun install
bun run build
echo '{"plugin": ["file://'$(pwd)'"]}' > ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
```

Restart OpenCode to load the plugin.

### 3. Configure Connection

Default: connects to `localhost:8888`. Override via:
- Env var: `export HINDSIGHT_BASE_URL="http://localhost:8888"`
- Config file: `~/.config/opencode/hindsight.jsonc` with `{"baseUrl": "http://localhost:8888"}`

## Project Structure

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Plugin entry point — registers OpenCode hooks (`chat.message`, `tool.hindsight`, `event`) |
| `src/cli.ts` | CLI installer and `/hindsight-init` command |
| `src/config.ts` | Configuration loading (env > config file > defaults) and type definitions |
| `src/services/client.ts` | Hindsight API client wrapper (search, add, delete, list, profile, ingest) |
| `src/services/context.ts` | Formats memories into prompt context blocks |
| `src/services/compaction.ts` | Context window compaction and session summarization |
| `src/services/tags.ts` | Auto-generates bank names using SHA-256 hashes |
| `src/services/privacy.ts` | Strips `<private>...</private>` content from memories |
| `src/services/jsonc.ts` | Strips JSONC comments for config parsing |
| `src/services/logger.ts` | File-based logging to `~/.opencode-hindsight.log` |
| `src/types/index.ts` | Shared TypeScript type definitions |
| `deploy/docker-compose.yml` | Docker Compose setup for Hindsight server (DeepSeek integration) |
| `deploy/.env.example` | Environment variable template for deployment |
| `package.json` | Package manifest (ESM, v1.0.0, MIT) |

## Dependencies

| Package | Version | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `@opencode-ai/plugin` | ^1.0.162 | OpenCode plugin SDK |
| `@vectorize-io/hindsight-client` | ^0.5.3 | Hindsight REST API client |

## Scripts

| Script | Command |
|---|---|
| `build` | `bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node && bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./dist/cli.js --target node && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` |
| `dev` | `tsc --watch` |
| `typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit` |

## Architecture

### Plugin Hooks
- **`chat.message`**: On first message in a session, injects user profile + project memories as context. Scans user messages for memory trigger keywords (e.g., "remember", "save this").
- **`tool.hindsight`**: Exposes a single `hindsight` tool with modes: `add`, `search`, `profile`, `list`, `forget`, `help`. Supports scopes (`user`/`project`) and types (`project-config`, `architecture`, `error-solution`, `preference`, `learned-pattern`, `conversation`).
- **`event`**: Handles `session.deleted` and `message.updated` for context compaction.

### Memory Scopes
| Scope | Tag | Persists |
|---|---|---|
| User | `hindsight_user_{sha256(git_email)}` | All projects |
| Project | `hindsight_project_{sha256(directory)}` | This project |

### Configuration (`~/.config/opencode/hindsight.jsonc`)

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | string | `http://localhost:8888` | Hindsight server URL |
| `similarityThreshold` | number | `0.6` | Min similarity for memory retrieval (0-1) |
| `maxMemories` | number | `5` | Max memories injected per request |
| `maxProjectMemories` | number | `10` | Max project memories listed |
| `maxProfileItems` | number | `5` | Max profile facts injected |
| `injectProfile` | boolean | `true` | Include user profile in context |
| `bankPrefix` | string | `"opencode"` | Prefix for auto-generated bank names |
| `userBank` | string | — | Explicit user bank name |
| `projectBank` | string | — | Explicit project bank name |
| `maxTokens` | number | `4096` | Max tokens for recall operations |
| `budget` | string | `"mid"` | Recall budget: `low`, `mid`, or `high` |
| `keywordPatterns` | string[] | — | Extra regex patterns for memory detection |
| `compactionThreshold` | number | `0.8` | Context usage ratio triggering compaction |

### Important Notes
- **`add` operation is asynchronous by default** to prevent timeouts during memory processing
- **Metadata values must be strings** — non-string values are auto-converted
- **Response includes `operationId`** for tracking async operations
- **API timeout** is 120 seconds

## Key Implementation Details

### Bank Selection
Banks are auto-generated: `{prefix}_user_{sha256(git_email)}` for user, `{prefix}_project_{sha256(cwd)}` for project. Override via `userBank`/`projectBank` config.

### Privacy
Content wrapped in `<private>...</private>` tags is never stored in Hindsight. Detection and stripping happen client-side before API calls.

### Compaction
When context usage reaches `compactionThreshold` (default 80%):
1. Triggers OpenCode's summarization
2. Injects project memories into summary context
3. Saves session summary as a memory

### Context Injection
On first message, the agent receives a `[HINDSIGHT]` block containing user profile facts, project memories, and relevant user memories — invisible to the user.
